Counts of soil-health scores

Source: R/health-read.R
soil_health_summary.Rd

Counts the scores a soil_health_scores() selection holds, without reading them (POST /query/soil-health/summary): in total and by dataset, release, source support, category, class and status.

Usage

soil_health_summary(
  soil = soil_session(),
  providers = NULL,
  datasets = NULL,
  release_ids = NULL,
  release_codes = NULL,
  model_versions = NULL,
  run_ids = NULL,
  categories = NULL,
  score_classes = NULL,
  statuses = NULL,
  source_supports = NULL,
  country = NULL,
  bbox = NULL,
  depth_top_cm = NULL,
  depth_bottom_cm = NULL
)

Arguments

soil

A session; the default session when omitted. Client-side: not sent to the API.

providers

Provider codes. API field providers.

datasets

Catalog dataset codes. API field datasets.

release_ids, release_codes

Releases of the scored horizons. API fields release_ids and release_codes.

model_versions

Soil-health model version codes (an unknown code is refused by the API). API field model_versions.

run_ids

Product run ids (API field product_run_ids).

categories

Category codes ("physical", "chemical", ...). API field categories.

score_classes

Score classes. API field score_classes.

statuses

Score statuses: "scored", "insufficient_data", "not_applicable" (API field score_statuses).

source_supports

Source supports ("point_observation", "polygon_estimate", ...). API field source_supports.

country

Countries as ISO 3166 alpha-2 or alpha-3 codes or names. API field country.

bbox

c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) in WGS84 degrees. API field bbox.

depth_top_cm, depth_bottom_cm

Depth interval in cm: the horizons overlapping it. API fields depth_top_cm and depth_bottom_cm.

Value

A soil_health_summary list: total_score_count, feature_count, horizon_count and the data frames by_dataset (dataset, provider, score_count, feature_count, horizon_count), by_release (release_id, release_code, score_count), by_source_support (source_support, score_count), by_category (category, variable, score_count), by_class (score_class, score_count), by_status (score_status, score_count), and metadata.

Details

Rights: soil:summary. Capabilities: query_soil_health; country_filtering for country.

See also

Other thematic reads: soil_health_scores(), soil_resolve_targets(), soil_ttr_flags(), soil_values(), soil_values_summary()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
soil_health_summary(soil, country = "TUN")$by_class
} # }
